name: Grace Breeding
summary: Grace Breeding Ltd, an agro-tech company, engages in the research and development in the area of biological substitutes for synthetic materials used in the fertilizer and growth promoter industries in Israel and internationally. The company also sells seeds. Its product portfolio includes Maoz, a biofertilizer that aids with photosynthesis; ProMagen, a combination of plant materials with anti-inflammatory properties for biotic stress tolerance; and ClimAid for abiotic stress tolerance. Grace Breeding Ltd was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Ramat Gan, Israel.
